reaction_information: All mandatory stress parameters become known at the beginning of 2038. Existing commitments cannot be cancelled; additional B/E orders respect their lead times.

resolutions.Q01_PRESTART_AVAILABILITY: Preparatory B orders and deliveries in 2034 are allowed solely to fund opening inventory; the existing 70 t depot is available. Apply the same lead time, capacity, prices and loss rate. Conditional team interpretation of the explicit preparatory-period requirement, not an edit of the CSV.
resolutions.Q02_C_DELIVERY_SCHEDULE: 24 months preparation after exercise, then a separately disclosed conservative 4-month recurring delivery lead time. No second 24-month preparation per shipment.
resolutions.Q03_ZBO_COMMISSIONING: Payment no earlier than 2036; installation takes 6 model months, with no outage. Old regime remains active until commissioning. Study delayed commissioning separately.
resolutions.Q04_ISRU_FIRST_DELIVERY: Commission no earlier than 2038 after funding strictly before 2038; first and subsequent orders require 2 months after the order and cannot be placed before commissioning.
resolutions.Q05_REAL_DISCOUNT_RATE: 10% real annual planning rate, reference day 0 (start of 2035), identical across alternatives; compare 0/5/10/15%. Not a market estimate.
